items.definition:
the act of rejecting or being rejected
His proposal met with immediate rejection.

a large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply
The city's water supply comes from the large reservoir.

a physical feeling or perception
She felt a burning sensation in her hand.

a long, narrow part or section forming the handle or main body of a tool or weapon
A shaft of light pierced through the clouds.

a form of transport that travels regularly between two places
The airport shuttle runs every 30 minutes.

a lamp projecting a narrow, intense beam of light directly onto a place or person
The singer stood in the spotlight.

a member or supporter of the Conservative Party in the UK
The Tory party won the election.

a group of three people or things
The Holy Trinity is a central doctrine in Christianity.

a large room or chamber used for storage, especially an underground one
The bank keeps its money in a secure vault.

a former student of a particular school, college, or university
He is an alumnus of Harvard University.

a person who buys and sells goods or assets for others
She works as a stock broker.

a person legally entitled to the property or rank of another on that person's death
He was the sole heir to the fortune.

a home run in baseball
He hit a grand slam homer in the ninth inning.

the state of being imprisoned; captivity
He faced a long period of imprisonment.

the middle part or stage
He found himself in the midst of a crowd.

each of a set of standardized parts or independent units that can be used to construct a more complex structure
The course is divided into several modules.

moss
The old stones were covered in green moss.

plague
The Black Death was a devastating plague.

solidarity
The workers showed solidarity with their colleagues.

specialty
Italian food is their specialty.

tomb
The ancient king was buried in a grand tomb.

trademark
The company registered its new logo as a trademark.

voyage
The ship embarked on a long voyage across the ocean.

abbey
Westminster Abbey is a famous church in London.

adjustment
She made a small adjustment to the settings.

attachment
I sent the document as an email attachment.

bomber
The bomber aircraft flew over the city.

a tight grasp; a small bag
He kept a tight clutch on the steering wheel.

the quality of being trusted and believed in
The scandal damaged his credibility as a leader.

a quantity of something obtained
The fishermen returned with a large haul of fish.

the sum of a person's actions in this and previous states of existence, viewed as deciding their fate in future existences.
He believes in good karma coming back to you.

human beings collectively
The future of mankind depends on our actions today.

the process of making maps or assigning relationships
GPS technology is used for accurate mapping.

an army of ordinary citizens
The local militia was called upon to defend the town.

a point in a network or system
Each computer acts as a node in the network.

nearness in space, time, or relationship
The proximity of the two houses made it easy to visit.

a person who occupies land or property rented from a landlord
The tenant signed a new lease agreement.

the process or result of calculating
The engineer made a careful calculation before building the bridge.

a person who studies or writes about economics
The economist predicted a rise in inflation next year.

the action or process of forgiving or being forgiven
It takes courage to ask for forgiveness.

a precious or semiprecious stone, especially one cut and polished
She wore a necklace with a beautiful blue gem.

a low-growing evergreen shrub with small, bell-shaped pink or purple flowers
The hills were covered in purple heather.

an area of low-lying land that is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times
Birds often nest in the marsh near the river.

the state, fact, or period of being mature
She showed great maturity for her age.

a machine or person that processes something
The computer's processor is very fast.

a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metallic element
Salt is made of sodium and chloride.

an amount of something left over when requirements have been met; an excess
The company reported a budget surplus this year.

abdominal muscles; anti-lock braking system
He works out his abs every day.

a very large quantity of something
The region has an abundance of natural resources.

a raw material or primary agricultural product that can be bought and sold
Oil is a valuable commodity.

a male member of a congress
The congressman voted on the new bill.

a hard stony substance formed by marine polyps
The Great Barrier Reef is made of coral.

a person who writes letters or reports for a newspaper or broadcast
The war correspondent reported live from the front lines.

extreme tiredness
The long journey caused him great fatigue.

the outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity
He was on the fringe of the crowd.

a very hard, granular, crystalline igneous rock
The kitchen countertops are made of granite.

an innate, typically fixed pattern of behavior
Birds build nests by instinct.

the ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions
He showed good judgement in a difficult situation.

a large group of people or things
A legion of fans waited outside the stadium.

the detailed organization and implementation of a complex operation
The logistics of organizing the event were complicated.

a player in the middle of the field in sports like soccer
The midfielder scored a goal from outside the box.

the established set of attitudes held by someone
She has a positive mindset towards challenges.

principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong behavior
The story explores themes of morality and justice.

a straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere
The explosion had an impact radius of five miles.
